Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

You emphasise the relationship, and your team has confirmed spare capacity—it seems predictable business would be particularly valuable to you. We want a straightforward, longer-term arrangement with competitive pricing for the complete kit. What bundle discount could you secure through your pricing committee in exchange for a longer contract?

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today. Our kit calculation: at your own current prices (19 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8 at EUR 12.46/100; 21 x Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 at EUR 4.91/100; 23 x Washer ISO 7089 M12 at EUR 12.78/1000) plus the part you do not supply us yet (6 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 at today's EUR 37.64/100), the kit costs EUR 5.95. Your offer of EUR 5.74 is a 3.5% bundle discount for the whole kit on a multi-year single-source volume; we consider EUR 4.94 a fair kit price. That is a contract worth about EUR 188,700 a year. Our demand forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 is up +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09). Our demand forecast for Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 is up +9.0% (fc:360012@2026-09). Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.60. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.94 per unit, 90 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.88 per unit, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract and have taken the verified volume increases into account. 

In exchange for the longer term and bundled volume, we can offer a revised price of €5.52 per unit with 30 days payment terms. For your records, our offer comprises a price of €5.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Furthermore, our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current offer is a price of €5.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We can offer a further reduction to €5.45 per unit, provided we maintain the 30-day payment terms, as extended terms increase our costs.
